messages:
Ana H: Heads-up — bringing up merlin-lite-q4 for structured-output QA. spotted weird double-invoke when retry kicks in.
Sasha P: details? failing on schema validation or duplicate tool side effects?
Ana H: schema failures and duplicate tool calls. sometimes model emits complete json then appends a natural language explanation, parser chokes then retry triggers another invocation to the tool.
Kevin L: retries are blind replays — if model already sent the tool call we end up calling twice.
Mike R: sample payload:
User: {"user_id":123, "intent":"charge", "amount":49}
Model: {"tool":"charge_card","args":{"amount":49,"token":"tok_abc"}} please confirm the charge
Sasha P: trailing "please confirm" after the JSON is killing strict JSON parsers.
Ana H: current onboard config: 3 retries, immediate backoff, strict-json linting. parse_failures spike at 6% for merlin-lite-q4 vs 0.4% baseline.
Kevin L: hypothesis: q4 changed EOS timing; model sometimes appends commentary. our retry logic assumes parse failure => never called.
Sasha P: mitigation ideas: idempotent-aware retry, soft-parse to extract first top-level JSON, rescue NDJSON split.
Kevin L: for side-effect tools require sentinel or tokenizer heuristic: '}' followed by newline/EOF and <=5 trailing chars.
Mike R: patch idea: regex extractor re.search(r'(\{.*?\})', text, flags=re.DOTALL) then json.loads; log original.
Sasha P: prototype works. will push patch branch and add unit test injecting trailing text.
Ana H: also reduce retries to 1 for merlin-lite-q4 and mark side_effects: disabled in config for now.
deploy-bot: canary-check merlin-lite-q4 @eng-ml — parsing_failure_rate=6.2% (1000 samples), dup_tool_invokes=0.9%
Sasha P: added duplicate-call guard: before calling, check recent calls for same (user_id, tool, args_hash) within 5s.
Ana H: metrics: capture token-offset of closing brace, sentinel_present, parse_method (strict/soft/regex). add to onboarding telemetry.
Kevin L: please open PR for telemetry fields + reduced retries. tag me.
Ana H: PR #2345 created — includes soft-parse, duplicate-call guard, reduced retries, dashboard events.
Sasha P: will run 2000-sample canary tomorrow.
Mike R: schedule postmortem if regression persists.
Ana H: adding onboarding checklist note about sentinel behavior under quantization.
Sasha P: merging after Kevin review. good work team :rocket:
